author: Greg Dealba
text: These guys are great and Mrs Donna is as sweet as can be! They where able to show up the day I called and even educated me on the system I had. After discovering an issue in my pump tank the next day they where even nice enough to come back and assist. I highly recommend them for all your septic needs! Thanks again and see ya in a few years!

author: Joan Waters
text: Great family owned business!  Professional, Reliable,  competitive pricing and friendly.   Very accommodating with appointments!  We have used them for about 20 years and have always been satisfied!!  Highly recommend Royal Flush for all your septic tank needs.

author: silver992v
text: Ive used this company for 15 years. Highly recommend,  great communication, fast and affordable service done right. They genuinely care about keeping your system in top shape.

author: R L
text:
5 stars ⭐ well deserved!
Absolutely an amazing experience. The team was highly professional, and what really stood out was that the owner personally arrived with them. He took the time to recommend adding a filter to our septic tank, which we didn’t have. His knowledge and expertise gave us confidence that his recommendation will save us a lot of money in the future.
They made sure everything was done thoroughly and professionally, and they were very mindful of our lawn throughout the process. They not only cleared out the septic tank but also pressure cleaned it until it was squeaky clean!
On top of that, their pricing is unbeatable for the level of service provided. We couldn’t be more satisfied and will definitely be customers for life! 💯 🇺🇸

author: Lacey Richardson
text: Called them late in the afternoon to have our septic tank pumped and they came first thing in the am. They were all very nice and getting us in was not a problem. Best part was they were the cheapest around here to get it done for us. Will recommend them in the future! Give Mrs. Donna a call!
